from solution import Service


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


def make(**kw):
    c = Clock()
    s = Service(c, **kw)
    s.register_user("ann", "member")
    s.register_user("bob", "member")
    s.register_user("st", "staff")
    for i in range(5):
        s.add_item("i%d" % i, "thing")
    return s, c


def test_register_validation():
    s = Service(Clock())
    assert s.register_user("", "member")[0] == 400
    assert s.register_user("a", "admin")[0] == 400
    assert s.register_user(1, "member")[0] == 400
    assert s.register_user("a", "member")[0] == 201
    assert s.register_user("a", "staff")[0] == 409


def test_add_item_validation():
    s = Service(Clock())
    assert s.add_item("", "n")[0] == 400
    assert s.add_item("x", "")[0] == 400
    assert s.add_item("x", "n")[0] == 201
    assert s.add_item("y", "n")[0] == 201
    assert s.add_item("x", "m")[0] == 409


def test_checkout_order_and_limits():
    s, c = make()
    assert s.checkout("zz", "nope")[0] == 404
    assert s.checkout("ann", "nope")[0] == 404
    st, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    assert st == 200 and b == {"loan_id": 1, "due_at": 1007.0}
    assert s.checkout("bob", "i0")[0] == 409
    s.checkout("ann", "i1")
    s.checkout("ann", "i2")
    assert s.checkout("ann", "i3")[0] == 422
    assert s.checkout("ann", "i0")[0] == 409  # item check before limit


def test_return_rules():
    s, c = make()
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    lid = b["loan_id"]
    assert s.return_loan("ann", 99)[0] == 404
    assert s.return_loan("bob", lid)[0] == 403
    assert s.item_status("i0") == (200, {"available": False, "loan_id": lid})
    assert s.return_loan("st", lid) == (200, {"item_id": "i0"})
    assert s.return_loan("ann", lid)[0] == 409
    assert s.return_loan("bob", lid)[0] == 403
    assert s.item_status("i0") == (200, {"available": True, "loan_id": None})


def test_renew_rules():
    s, c = make()
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    lid = b["loan_id"]
    assert s.renew_loan("bob", lid)[0] == 403
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", 9)[0] == 404
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", lid) == (200, {"due_at": 1014.0})
    assert s.renew_loan("st", lid) == (200, {"due_at": 1021.0})
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", lid)[0] == 422
    c.t = 1021.0
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", lid)[0] == 422  # not strictly overdue
    c.t = 1021.5
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", lid)[0] == 409


def test_renew_overdue_boundary():
    s, c = make()
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    c.t = 1007.0
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", b["loan_id"])[0] == 200
    c.t = 1014.1
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", b["loan_id"])[0] == 409


def test_renew_returned_409():
    s, c = make()
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    s.return_loan("ann", b["loan_id"])
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", b["loan_id"])[0] == 409


def test_list_loans_sorted_and_scoped():
    s, c = make()
    s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    s.checkout("bob", "i1")
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i2")
    s.return_loan("ann", 1)
    st, loans = s.list_loans("ann")
    assert st == 200
    assert [l["loan_id"] for l in loans] == [1, 3]
    assert [l["status"] for l in loans] == ["returned", "active"]
    assert s.list_loans("nobody")[0] == 404


def test_configurable_limits():
    s, c = make(max_loans=1, max_renewals=0, loan_period=2.0)
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    assert b["due_at"] == 1002.0
    assert s.checkout("ann", "i1")[0] == 422
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", b["loan_id"])[0] == 422
    s2, _ = make(max_loans=0)
    assert s2.checkout("ann", "i0")[0] == 422


def test_return_frees_slot_for_limit():
    s, c = make(max_loans=1)
    s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    s.return_loan("ann", 1)
    assert s.checkout("ann", "i1")[0] == 200

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = float(t)

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def advance(self, dt):
        self.t += float(dt)


def make(max_loans=3, max_renewals=2, loan_period=7.0, t=1000.0):
    clock = FakeClock(t)
    svc = Service(clock, max_loans=max_loans, max_renewals=max_renewals,
                  loan_period=loan_period)
    return svc, clock


def setup(svc, users=(("m1", "member"), ("m2", "member"), ("st", "staff")),
          items=("i1", "i2", "i3", "i4", "i5")):
    for u, r in users:
        out = svc.register_user(u, r)
        assert out[0] == 201, f"input={(u, r)!r} output={out!r}"
    for i in items:
        out = svc.add_item(i, "name-" + i)
        assert out[0] == 201, f"input={i!r} output={out!r}"


invalid_ids = st.one_of(st.just(""), st.none(), st.integers(), st.binary(),
                        st.booleans(), st.floats(allow_nan=False))
invalid_roles = st.one_of(
    st.text().filter(lambda r: r not in ("member", "staff")),
    st.none(), st.integers(), st.booleans())


# ---------------- REQ-1 register ----------------

def test_register_user_success_body():
    """REQ-1: a valid register_user returns 201 with the user_id and role."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.register_user("alice", "member")
    assert out == (201, {"user_id": "alice", "role": "member"}), f"input=('alice','member') output={out!r}"
    out = svc.register_user("bob", "staff")
    assert out == (201, {"user_id": "bob", "role": "staff"}), f"input=('bob','staff') output={out!r}"


def test_register_user_duplicate_409():
    """REQ-1: registering an existing user_id returns 409."""
    svc, _ = make()
    svc.register_user("alice", "member")
    out = svc.register_user("alice", "member")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('alice','member') output={out!r}"


def test_register_duplicate_keeps_original_role():
    """REQ-1: a rejected duplicate registration must not change the stored role."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc, users=(("m1", "member"), ("m2", "member")), items=("i1",))
    out = svc.register_user("m2", "staff")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('m2','staff') output={out!r}"
    _, body = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    out = svc.return_loan("m2", body["loan_id"])
    assert out[0] == 403, f"input=('m2', {body['loan_id']!r}) output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("uid,role", [("", "member"), ("u", ""), ("u", "admin"),
                                      ("u", "Member"), ("u", "STAFF"), (None, "member"),
                                      (5, "member"), ("u", None), ("u", 3)])
def test_register_invalid_400(uid, role):
    """REQ-1: an invalid user_id or role returns 400."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.register_user(uid, role)
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input={(uid, role)!r} output={out!r}"


@given(uid=invalid_ids)
def test_prop_register_invalid_id_400(uid):
    """REQ-1: any non-str or empty user_id returns 400."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.register_user(uid, "member")
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input={(uid, 'member')!r} output={out!r}"


@given(role=invalid_roles)
def test_prop_register_invalid_role_400_and_not_created(role):
    """REQ-1: an invalid role returns 400 and no user is created."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.register_user("u", role)
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input={('u', role)!r} output={out!r}"
    out2 = svc.list_loans("u")
    assert out2[0] == 404, f"input='u' output={out2!r}"


@given(uid=st.text(min_size=1), role=st.sampled_from(["member", "staff"]))
def test_prop_register_valid_201(uid, role):
    """REQ-1: any non-empty str id with a valid role registers with 201."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.register_user(uid, role)
    assert out == (201, {"user_id": uid, "role": role}), f"input={(uid, role)!r} output={out!r}"
    out2 = svc.register_user(uid, role)
    assert out2[0] == 409, f"input={(uid, role)!r} output={out2!r}"


# ---------------- REQ-2 add_item ----------------

def test_add_item_success_body():
    """REQ-2: a valid add_item returns 201 with item_id and name."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.add_item("i1", "Oscilloscope")
    assert out == (201, {"item_id": "i1", "name": "Oscilloscope"}), f"input=('i1','Oscilloscope') output={out!r}"


def test_add_item_duplicate_409_even_with_other_name():
    """REQ-2: adding an existing item_id returns 409 regardless of name."""
    svc, _ = make()
    svc.add_item("i1", "A")
    for name in ("A", "B"):
        out = svc.add_item("i1", name)
        assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('i1',{name!r}) output={out!r}"


def test_add_item_same_name_distinct_ids_ok():
    """REQ-2: two distinct items may share the same name."""
    svc, _ = make()
    assert svc.add_item("i1", "Same")[0] == 201
    out = svc.add_item("i2", "Same")
    assert out == (201, {"item_id": "i2", "name": "Same"}), f"input=('i2','Same') output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("iid,name", [("", "n"), ("i", ""), (None, "n"), ("i", None),
                                      (1, "n"), ("i", 2)])
def test_add_item_invalid_400(iid, name):
    """REQ-2: an invalid item_id or name returns 400."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.add_item(iid, name)
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input={(iid, name)!r} output={out!r}"


@given(iid=invalid_ids)
def test_prop_add_item_invalid_id_400(iid):
    """REQ-2: any non-str or empty item_id returns 400."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.add_item(iid, "n")
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input={(iid, 'n')!r} output={out!r}"


@given(iid=st.text(min_size=1), name=st.text(min_size=1))
def test_prop_add_item_valid_201_then_status(iid, name):
    """REQ-2/7: any non-empty str id and name creates an available item."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.add_item(iid, name)
    assert out == (201, {"item_id": iid, "name": name}), f"input={(iid, name)!r} output={out!r}"
    st_out = svc.item_status(iid)
    assert st_out == (200, {"available": True, "loan_id": None}), f"input={iid!r} output={st_out!r}"


# ---------------- REQ-3 checkout ----------------

def test_checkout_success_body_and_due_at():
    """REQ-3: checkout returns 200 with loan_id 1 and due_at = now + loan_period."""
    svc, clock = make(t=500.0)
    setup(svc)
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    assert out == (200, {"loan_id": 1, "due_at": 507.0}), f"input=('m1','i1') output={out!r}"
    assert isinstance(out[1]["loan_id"], int) and isinstance(out[1]["due_at"], float), f"output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_custom_loan_period():
    """REQ-3/9: due_at uses the configured loan_period."""
    svc, _ = make(loan_period=2.5, t=10.0)
    setup(svc)
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    assert out == (200, {"loan_id": 1, "due_at": 12.5}), f"input=('m1','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_loan_ids_sequential_across_users():
    """REQ-3: loan ids are assigned sequentially from 1 across all users."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    ids = [svc.checkout(u, i)[1]["loan_id"] for u, i in
           [("m1", "i1"), ("m2", "i2"), ("st", "i3")]]
    assert ids == [1, 2, 3], f"output={ids!r}"


def test_checkout_unknown_user_404():
    """REQ-3: an unregistered user gets 404."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    out = svc.checkout("ghost", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('ghost','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_unknown_item_404():
    """REQ-3: an item not in the catalog gets 404."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "nope")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('m1','nope') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_unknown_user_precedes_item_on_loan():
    """REQ-3: unknown user (404) is checked before the item being on loan (409)."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    out = svc.checkout("ghost", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('ghost','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_unknown_item_precedes_limit():
    """REQ-3: unknown item (404) is checked before the loan limit (422)."""
    svc, _ = make(max_loans=1)
    setup(svc)
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "nope")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('m1','nope') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_item_on_loan_409_by_other_and_same_user():
    """REQ-3: an item with an active loan returns 409 for any user."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    for u in ("m2", "m1", "st"):
        out = svc.checkout(u, "i1")
        assert out[0] == 409, f"input=({u!r},'i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_item_on_loan_precedes_limit():
    """REQ-3: item-on-loan (409) takes precedence over the loan limit (422)."""
    svc, _ = make(max_loans=1)
    setup(svc)
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    svc.checkout("m2", "i2")
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i2")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('m1','i2') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_default_limit_three_then_422():
    """REQ-3/9: with defaults a user can hold three active loans; the fourth is 422."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    for i in ("i1", "i2", "i3"):
        out = svc.checkout("m1", i)
        assert out[0] == 200, f"input=('m1',{i!r}) output={out!r}"
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i4")
    assert out[0] == 422, f"input=('m1','i4') output={out!r}"
    assert svc.item_status("i4") == (200, {"available": True, "loan_id": None})


def test_checkout_limit_is_per_user():
    """REQ-9: the loan limit applies per user."""
    svc, _ = make(max_loans=1)
    setup(svc)
    assert svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[0] == 200
    out = svc.checkout("m2", "i2")
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input=('m2','i2') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_limit_zero_always_422():
    """REQ-3/9: with max_loans=0 every checkout of an available item is 422."""
    svc, _ = make(max_loans=0)
    setup(svc)
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 422, f"input=('m1','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_returned_loan_frees_capacity():
    """REQ-3/4: a returned loan no longer counts toward max_loans."""
    svc, _ = make(max_loans=1)
    setup(svc)
    lid = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    assert svc.checkout("m1", "i2")[0] == 422
    assert svc.return_loan("m1", lid)[0] == 200
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i2")
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input=('m1','i2') output={out!r}"


def test_failed_checkouts_do_not_consume_loan_ids():
    """REQ-3: a loan is only created on success, so ids stay consecutive after failures."""
    svc, _ = make(max_loans=1)
    setup(svc)
    assert svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[1]["loan_id"] == 1
    svc.checkout("ghost", "i2")
    svc.checkout("m1", "nope")
    svc.checkout("m2", "i1")
    svc.checkout("m1", "i2")
    out = svc.checkout("m2", "i2")
    assert out == (200, {"loan_id": 2, "due_at": 1007.0}), f"output={out!r}"


@given(limit=st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=6), n_items=st.integers(min_value=1, max_value=10))
def test_prop_checkout_respects_limit(limit, n_items):
    """REQ-9: a user succeeds in exactly max_loans checkouts and later ones return 422."""
    svc, _ = make(max_loans=limit)
    items = [f"it{k}" for k in range(n_items)]
    setup(svc, users=(("u", "member"),), items=items)
    statuses = [svc.checkout("u", i)[0] for i in items]
    expected = [200] * min(limit, n_items) + [422] * (n_items - min(limit, n_items))
    assert statuses == expected, f"input=(limit={limit}, n={n_items}) output={statuses!r}"


@given(t=st.floats(min_value=0, max_value=1e6, allow_nan=False, allow_infinity=False),
       period=st.floats(min_value=0.001, max_value=1e4, allow_nan=False, allow_infinity=False))
def test_prop_due_at_is_now_plus_period(t, period):
    """REQ-3/10: due_at equals clock.now() + loan_period at the time of checkout."""
    svc, _ = make(loan_period=period, t=t)
    setup(svc, users=(("u", "member"),), items=("i",))
    out = svc.checkout("u", "i")
    assert out[0] == 200 and out[1]["due_at"] == pytest.approx(t + period), \
        f"input=(t={t!r}, period={period!r}) output={out!r}"


# ---------------- REQ-4 return ----------------

def test_return_success_frees_item():
    """REQ-4: returning an owned active loan returns 200 {item_id} and frees the item."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    lid = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    out = svc.return_loan("m1", lid)
    assert out == (200, {"item_id": "i1"}), f"input=('m1',{lid}) output={out!r}"
    st_out = svc.item_status("i1")
    assert st_out == (200, {"available": True, "loan_id": None}), f"output={st_out!r}"


def test_return_unknown_loan_404():
    """REQ-4: an unknown loan_id returns 404."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    for lid in (1, 0, -1, 999):
        out = svc.return_loan("m1", lid)
        assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('m1',{lid}) output={out!r}"


def test_return_unknown_loan_404_precedes_ownership():
    """REQ-4: unknown loan (404) is checked before ownership for a member caller."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    out = svc.return_loan("m2", 42)
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('m2',42) output={out!r}"


def test_return_by_non_owner_member_403_and_no_change():
    """REQ-4/8: a non-owner member gets 403 and the loan stays active."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    lid = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    out = svc.return_loan("m2", lid)
    assert out[0] == 403, f"input=('m2',{lid}) output={out!r}"
    st_out = svc.item_status("i1")
    assert st_out == (200, {"available": False, "loan_id": lid}), f"output={st_out!r}"


def test_return_twice_409():
    """REQ-4: returning an already returned loan gives 409."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    lid = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    svc.return_loan("m1", lid)
    out = svc.return_loan("m1", lid)
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('m1',{lid}) output={out!r}"
    out = svc.return_loan("st", lid)
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('st',{lid}) output={out!r}"


def test_return_ownership_precedes_returned_check():
    """REQ-4: 403 for a non-owner member takes precedence over 409 for a returned loan."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    lid = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    svc.return_loan("m1", lid)
    out = svc.return_loan("m2", lid)
    assert out[0] == 403, f"input=('m2',{lid}) output={out!r}"


def test_staff_can_return_any_loan():
    """REQ-8: staff may return a loan owned by another user."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    lid = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    out = svc.return_loan("st", lid)
    assert out == (200, {"item_id": "i1"}), f"input=('st',{lid}) output={out!r}"
    loans = svc.list_loans("m1")[1]
    assert loans[0]["status"] == "returned", f"output={loans!r}"


def test_item_can_be_checked_out_again_after_return_with_new_id():
    """REQ-3/4: a returned item can be loaned again under a new loan_id."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    l1 = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    svc.return_loan("m1", l1)
    out = svc.checkout("m2", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 200 and out[1]["loan_id"] == 2, f"input=('m2','i1') output={out!r}"
    assert svc.item_status("i1") == (200, {"available": False, "loan_id": 2})


# ---------------- REQ-5 renew ----------------

def test_renew_success_extends_from_due_at():
    """REQ-5: renewal sets due_at to old due_at + loan_period, not now + loan_period."""
    svc, clock = make(t=100.0)
    setup(svc)
    lid = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    clock.advance(3.0)
    out = svc.renew_loan("m1", lid)
    assert out == (200, {"due_at": 114.0}), f"input=('m1',{lid}) output={out!r}"
    loans = svc.list_loans("m1")[1]
    assert loans[0]["due_at"] == 114.0 and loans[0]["renewals_used"] == 1, f"output={loans!r}"


def test_renew_unknown_loan_404():
    """REQ-5: an unknown loan_id returns 404."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)
    out = svc.renew_loan("m1", 5)
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('m1',5) output={out!r}"


def test_renew_non_owner_member_403():
    """REQ-5/8: a non-owner member gets 403."""
    svc, _ = make()
    setup(svc)

    st.tuples(st.just("checkout"), st.sampled_from(list(USERS)), st.sampled_from(ITEMS)),
    st.tuples(st.just("return"), st.sampled_from(list(USERS)), st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=10)),
    st.tuples(st.just("renew"), st.sampled_from(list(USERS)), st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=10)),
    st.tuples(st.just("advance"), st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=10), st.just(None)),
    st.tuples(st.just("list"), st.sampled_from(list(USERS)), st.just(None)),
    st.tuples(st.just("status"), st.sampled_from(ITEMS), st.just(None)),
)


@settings(max_examples=200, deadline=None)
@given(ops=st.lists(op_strategy, max_size=40),
       max_loans=st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=3),
       max_renewals=st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=3),
       period=st.sampled_from([1.0, 2.0, 7.0]))
def test_prop_model_based_behaviour(ops, max_loans, max_renewals, period):
    """REQ-3..9: arbitrary operation sequences match the specified check order and effects."""
    svc, clock = make(max_loans=max_loans, max_renewals=max_renewals,
                      loan_period=period, t=0.0)
    setup(svc, users=tuple(USERS.items()), items=ITEMS)
    loans = {}
    active_item = {}

    def check(op, got, exp_status, exp_body=None):
        assert got[0] == exp_status, f"input={op!r} output={got!r} expected_status={exp_status}"
        if exp_body is not None:
            assert got[1] == exp_body, f"input={op!r} output={got!r} expected_body={exp_body!r}"

    for op in ops:
        kind, a, b = op
        now = clock.t
        if kind == "advance":
            clock.advance(a)
        elif kind == "checkout":
            got = svc.checkout(a, b)
            if b in active_item:
                check(op, got, 409)
            elif sum(1 for l in loans.values() if l["user"] == a and l["status"] == "active") >= max_loans:
                check(op, got, 422)
            else:
                lid = len(loans) + 1
                loans[lid] = {"user": a, "item": b, "due": now + period, "ren": 0, "status": "active"}
                active_item[b] = lid
                check(op, got, 200, {"loan_id": lid, "due_at": now + period})
        elif kind in ("return", "renew"):
            got = svc.return_loan(a, b) if kind == "return" else svc.renew_loan(a, b)
            ln = loans.get(b)
            if ln is None:
                check(op, got, 404)
            elif ln["user"] != a and USERS[a] != "staff":
                check(op, got, 403)
            elif ln["status"] == "returned":
                check(op, got, 409)
            elif kind == "return":
                ln["status"] = "returned"
                del active_item[ln["item"]]
                check(op, got, 200, {"item_id": ln["item"]})
            elif now > ln["due"]:
                check(op, got, 409)
            elif ln["ren"] >= max_renewals:
                check(op, got, 422)
            else:
                ln["due"] += period
                ln["ren"] += 1
                check(op, got, 200, {"due_at": ln["due"]})
        elif kind == "list":
            exp = [{"loan_id": lid, "item_id": l["item"], "due_at": l["due"],
                    "renewals_used": l["ren"], "status": l["status"]}
                   for lid, l in sorted(loans.items()) if l["user"] == a]
            check(op, svc.list_loans(a), 200, exp)
        elif kind == "status":
            lid = active_item.get(a)
            check(op, svc.item_status(a), 200, {"available": lid is None, "loan_id": lid})

            if a not in USERS:

            else:

                exp = (200, {"available": lid is None, "loan_id": lid})
        if exp[0] != 200 and out[0] != 200:
            assert out[0] == exp[0], f"op={op!r} output={out!r} expected_status={exp[0]!r} history={ops!r}"

USERS_ALL = ["m1", "m2", "s1", "ghost"]
USERS_REG = ["m1", "m2", "s1"]
ITEMS = ["i1", "i2", "i3", "zz"]

op_strategy = st.one_of(
    st.tuples(st.just("checkout"), st.sampled_from(USERS_ALL), st.sampled_from(ITEMS)),
    st.tuples(st.just("return"), st.sampled_from(USERS_REG), st.sampled_from(list(range(1, 9)) + [99])),
    st.tuples(st.just("renew"), st.sampled_from(USERS_REG), st.sampled_from(list(range(1, 9)) + [99])),
    st.tuples(st.just("list"), st.sampled_from(USERS_ALL)),
    st.tuples(st.just("status"), st.sampled_from(ITEMS)),
    st.tuples(st.just("advance"), st.integers(0, 10)),
)


class Model:
    def __init__(self, max_loans, max_renewals, period):
        self.ml, self.mr, self.p = max_loans, max_renewals, period
        self.now = 0.0
        self.users = {"m1": "member", "m2": "member", "s1": "staff"}
        self.items = {"i1", "i2", "i3"}
        self.loans = {}
        self.on_loan = {}
        self.next = 1

    def checkout(self, u, i):
        if u not in self.users:
            return 404, None
        if i not in self.items:
            return 404, None
        if i in self.on_loan:
            return 409, None
        active = sum(1 for l in self.loans.values() if l["user"] == u and l["status"] == "active")
        if active >= self.ml:
            return 422, None
        lid = self.next
        self.next += 1
        self.loans[lid] = dict(user=u, item=i, due=self.now + self.p, ren=0, status="active")
        self.on_loan[i] = lid
        return 200, {"loan_id": lid, "due_at": self.now + self.p}

    def ret(self, u, lid):
        l = self.loans.get(lid)
        if l is None:
            return 404, None
        if l["user"] != u and self.users[u] != "staff":
            return 403, None
        if l["status"] == "returned":
            return 409, None
        l["status"] = "returned"
        del self.on_loan[l["item"]]
        return 200, {"item_id": l["item"]}

    def renew(self, u, lid):
        l = self.loans.get(lid)
        if l is None:
            return 404, None
        if l["user"] != u and self.users[u] != "staff":
            return 403, None
        if l["status"] == "returned":
            return 409, None
        if self.now > l["due"]:
            return 409, None
        if l["ren"] >= self.mr:
            return 422, None
        l["due"] += self.p
        l["ren"] += 1
        return 200, {"due_at": l["due"]}

    def lst(self, u):
        if u not in self.users:
            return 404, None
        out = [
            {"loan_id": k, "item_id": l["item"], "due_at": l["due"],
             "renewals_used": l["ren"], "status": l["status"]}
            for k, l in sorted(self.loans.items()) if l["user"] == u
        ]
        return 200, out

    def status(self, i):
        if i not in self.items:
            return 404, None
        return 200, {"available": i not in self.on_loan, "loan_id": self.on_loan.get(i)}
